Full representation [X_i, R_{-}]; reduced representation [R_{-}] (residual columns constant training fold dropped ). Fit learner representations, predict assessment rows, evaluate metric . importance = s * (metric_full − metric_reduced) s = +1 maximize metrics −1 minimize metrics, positive always means “keeping anchor helps”. what: Relation to the reference UMFI implementation
title: Shared predictive importance with sharedimp
text: reference implementation (https://github.com/HydroML/UMFI) fits residualization whole data set, gates slope p-value, scores random forests --bag R2R^2 accuracy floors, sets negative values zero. sharedimp residualizes inside training fold, always residualizes, uses paired per-fold assessment metrics learner, keeps negative values. Numerical identity therefore expected; specification recorded comparison docs/ directory source repository.

text: sharedimp R implementation linear-regression variant ultra-marginal feature importance (UMFI-LR; Janssen, Guan & Robeva, AISTATS 2023) designed modern, resampling-based machine-learning workflows. companion Python package name (sharedimp-py); follow specification docs/specification.md. claim new importance measure. package makes existing one safe convenient: fold-internal residualization: OLS coefficients used remove anchor’s linear component features estimated training rows fold applied, unchanged, assessment rows; paired full/reduced evaluation: model anchor model without evaluated assessment rows, fold fold; metric-independent sign: importance positive whenever keeping anchor predicts better, metrics maximize minimize alike; truncation: negative values reported, clipped zero; tidymodels adapters: parsnip learners, rsample resamples yardstick metrics, fixed hyperparameters seed argument; per-fold results always retained.

title: Fold-internal residualization (the UMFI-LR preprocessing) — residualize_fit
text: anchor every column j, b_j = Cov(x_i, x_j) / Var(x_i) a_j = mean(x_j) - b_j * mean(x_i), computed rows passed residualize_fit(). residualized column x_j - a_j - b_j * x_i. anchor constant rows, slopes set zero, intercepts become column means, warning raised. noise ever injected.

title: Learner adapters for shared_importance() — sharedimp_learner
text: shared_importance() accepts three kinds learner: string: "rand_forest" (default; ranger 500 trees min_n = 5, mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(x)))) "linear" (ordinary least squares, logistic regression, multinomial logistic regression via nnet, depending task); parsnip model specification whose mode matches task, used (hyperparameters fixed; nothing tuned); object created sharedimp_learner().

title: Learner adapters for shared_importance() — sharedimp_learner
code: ols <- sharedimp_learner(   fit = function(x, y) stats::lm.fit(cbind(1, x), y),   predict = function(model, x) {     beta <- model$coefficients     beta[is.na(beta)] <- 0     drop(cbind(1, x) %*% beta)   },   label = "OLS via lm.fit" ) set.seed(1) x <- matrix(rnorm(200), 50, 4, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("x", 1:4))) y <- x[, 1] + rnorm(50) shared_importance(x, y, learner = ols, v = 3, seed = 1) #> <sharedimp_result> #>   task:       regression #>   learner:    OLS via lm.fit #>   metric:     mse (minimize); importance = -(full - reduced) #>   resampling: 3-fold cross-validation (1 repeat) #>  #> # A tibble: 4 × 4 #>   feature importance     sd n_folds #>   <chr>        <dbl>  <dbl>   <int> #> 1 x1          0.365  0.874        3 #> 2 x2         -0.0707 0.0569       3 #> 3 x3          0.0961 0.0603       3 #> 4 x4         -0.189  0.455        3

title: sharedimp 0.1.0
text: Initial release. shared_importance(): UMFI-LR fold-internal residualization, paired full/reduced --sample evaluation, metric-direction-aware sign, truncation negative values, per-fold results, reproducible seed. Regression, binary multiclass classification; built-"rand_forest" (ranger) "linear" learners, parsnip model specification, custom sharedimp_learner(). Metrics via yardstick (mse, rmse, mae, rsq, mn_log_loss, accuracy, roc_auc, yardstick metric function). Low-level helpers residualize_fit(), residualize_apply(), build_representations(). Optional direction = TRUE diagnostic. Shared R/Python specification docs/specification.md; comparison reference implementation docs/umfi_comparison.md.
